milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the terracotta structure (centered at spawn-relative [9, 1, 7]) and face it. max_distance=5 requires the player to actually walk ~10 blocks from spawn to get close enough, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the terracotta.

Uses inventory_has because the player has a Silk Touch iron pickaxe, which causes pink stained glass to drop itself when mined. After breaking at least one block from the pink stained glass wall at [12-14, 0-2, 6-8], the item will appear in inventory. min_count=1 requires mining at least one block.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the gray concrete powder cluster (centered at spawn-relative [19, 0, 13]) and face it. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk ~22 blocks from spawn to the crafting area, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the concrete powder blocks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_carpet (2 white wool placed horizontally → 3 white_carpet) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The chest at [19,0,14] provides 2 white wool, and the crafting table at [17,0,14] is adjacent. min_count=1 is sufficient since the recipe produces 3.
